name: SYoung Group Co., Ltd.
summary: SYoung Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of cosmetic products in China. It provides facial masks, lotions, creams, makeup, and cleansing and personal care products. The company sells its products under the Yunifang, EVIDENSDEBEAUT, PIERAUG, RVive, Yu Nifang, Big Water Drop, Little Mihu, VAA and other brands.
